query.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.vessel_id') AS vessel_id, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.sea_surface_temp_c') AS REAL) AS sst_celsius, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.wave_height_meters') AS REAL) AS wave_height_m, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.ocean_current_knots') AS REAL) AS current_knots FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'RawMarineData' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 50) ORDER BY timestamp ASC

view.title: NUNEGAL-77 Sea Surface Temp & Wave Dynamics

query.sql: WITH LatestGPS AS (SELECT json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.vessel_id') AS vessel_id, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.latitude') AS REAL) AS lat, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.longitude') AS REAL) AS lon, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.speed_knots') AS REAL) AS speed, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.zone_id') AS zone, "$when" AS gps_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "$when" DESC) as rn FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'VesselGPSPosition'), LatestMarine AS (SELECT json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.vessel_id') AS vessel_id, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.sea_surface_temp_c') AS REAL) AS sst, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.wave_height_meters') AS REAL) AS wave_h, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.ocean_current_knots') AS REAL) AS current_speed, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.fetch_status') AS fetch_status, "$when" AS fetched_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "$when" DESC) as rn FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'RawMarineData'), LatestQuota AS (SELECT json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.haul_id') AS haul_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.quota_authorized') AS authorized, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.remaining_season_tons') AS REAL) AS remaining_quota, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.compliance_code') AS compliance, "$when" AS validated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "$when" DESC) as rn FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'HaulQuotaValidation') SELECT g.vessel_id AS Vessel, g.lat AS Latitude, g.lon AS Longitude, g.speed AS Speed_Knots, g.zone AS Active_Zone, m.sst AS Sea_Surface_Temp, m.wave_h AS Wave_Height_M, m.current_speed AS Ocean_Current_Knots, m.fetch_status AS REST_Fetch_Status, m.fetched_at AS Telemetry_Fetched_At, q.haul_id AS Last_Haul_ID, q.compliance AS Maritime_Auth_Status, q.remaining_quota AS Remaining_Fleet_Quota_Tons FROM LatestGPS g LEFT JOIN LatestMarine m ON m.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN LatestQuota q ON q.rn = 1 WHERE g.rn = 1

fields.name: ⚖️ Catch Biomass vs Fleet Quota Compliance

query.sql: WITH HaulEvents AS (SELECT json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.haul_id') AS haul_id, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.species') AS species, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.catch_tonnage') AS REAL) AS tonnage, "$when" AS haul_time FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'HaulRegistered'), QuotaEvents AS (SELECT json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.haul_id') AS haul_id, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.remaining_season_tons') AS REAL) AS remaining_tons, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.compliance_code') AS compliance FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'HaulQuotaValidation') SELECT h.haul_id AS Haul_Identifier, h.species AS Target_Species, h.tonnage AS Declared_Catch_Tons, COALESCE(q.remaining_tons, 140.0) AS Remaining_Season_Tons FROM HaulEvents h LEFT JOIN QuotaEvents q ON q.haul_id = h.haul_id ORDER BY h.haul_time DESC LIMIT 20

view.title: Haul Catch Weight vs Fleet Quota

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS Timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.vessel_id') AS Vessel, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.latitude') AS REAL) AS Latitude, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.longitude') AS REAL) AS Longitude, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.speed_knots') AS REAL) AS Speed_Knots, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.heading_deg') AS REAL) AS Heading_Deg, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.zone_id') AS Fishing_Zone FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'VesselGPSPosition' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 30
